prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: AUTO MERKOS 3:2 inventory card photograph — executive sedan
Primary request: Create a distinct original satin-silver full-size executive sedan with a long wheelbase, formal three-box profile, calm horizontal body lines, generous rear cabin, understated narrow grille, slim lamps and elegant dark multi-spoke wheels. The silhouette should feel composed and spacious rather than overtly sporty.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved composition reference; Image 2 is the approved hero photo and defines only the brutalist architectural studio, cool-gray palette, restrained lighting, low camera height, and photographic finish. Do not copy either image''s UI, text, brand cues, or hero wagon identity.
Scene/backdrop: the same monumental board-formed concrete gallery language, tall rectangular columns, deep shadow openings, smooth dark stone floor with only a subtle soft reflection, no furniture or signage.
Style/medium: photorealistic high-end European automotive editorial/catalog photography, physically believable proportions and surfaces, subtle natural grain, not glossy CGI.
Composition/framing: exact 3:2 landscape inventory-card composition, low eye-level front three-quarter view, full vehicle visible with clean roofline and all wheels inside frame, strong centered silhouette with calm architectural margins, no baked border or card chrome.
Lighting/mood: controlled overcast side daylight, soft sculpting highlights, near-black shadows, serious restrained showroom mood.
Color palette: neutral charcoal, graphite, silver, cool concrete; no bright accent color.
Constraints: one vehicle only; original fictional unbranded design; no people; no text; no logos; no badges; no recognizable manufacturer grille; no wheel-center emblem; no readable plate; no dealership signage; no watermark; no extra vehicles; accurate wheels, lamps, doors, mirrors and glass.
Avoid: copying Audi, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Volvo, Volkswagen, Range Rover or any recognizable model; concept-car exaggeration; cropped wheels; fisheye; motion blur; oversaturation; excessive bloom; visual clutter.
Materials/textures: satin silver metallic paint, rubber, dark glass, satin black trim, board-formed concrete.
Output intent: clean project-ready inventory photography suitable for an 1800x1200 WebP card.
